definition: A Stance lists what is accepted, what is core and what is demanded. Demanding p is the stance's own commitment that accepting p requires a reason. Honors S I w says everything S both demands and accepts is supported at w. NoneDemanded says nothing is demanded; CoreDemanded says every core commitment is. These bind only the stance that holds them.
note: Analyst-stated for #756, an instance of the #397 Norm schema. No person is attributed any of these stances.
